title: public_meeting
description: A Kansas Water Office public meeting event. A meeting is not an approval or a planning-region decision.

meeting_id.description: Stable governed identity for this public meeting.

meeting_type.description: Discriminant that distinguishes this record from AdvisoryCommitteeMeeting.

starts_at.description: Meeting start time. Must include timezone offset.

ends_at.description: Meeting end time, or null if not recorded.

location_description.description: Human-readable meeting location, or null for virtual-only.

virtual_access_posture.description: Indicates whether virtual participation is available.

cancellation_state.description: Current scheduling state. A cancellation is not a decision.

source_publication_time.description: Time the source published this meeting notice.
